itemListElement.name: Notion AI Note Taker Review for US Teams in 2026

mainEntity.name: Is the Notion AI note taker free?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Notion AI Meeting Notes is included on the Business plan ($20 per member per month) and Enterprise. Free and Plus plans get only a limited trial.

mainEntity.name: How do I use Notion's AI note taker?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open the Notion desktop app, type /meet on a page, click Start transcribing when the meeting begins, and click Stop when it ends. Notion writes the summary into the page.

mainEntity.name: Does Notion AI take meeting notes without a bot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Notion records audio from your computer through the desktop app, so no bot joins the call. That also means it only captures meetings where someone starts it.

mainEntity.name: Can Notion transcribe Zoom and Google Meet calls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Because it records your computer's audio, Notion AI Meeting Notes works with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams and other apps through the Notion desktop app.

mainEntity.name: Is Notion's note taker better than Granola?

acceptedAnswer.text: Notion is better if your team already uses Notion Business and wants notes inside its workspace. Granola is better as a standalone, cheaper note app with mobile capture on iPhone and Android.

mainEntity.name: Does Notion's AI note taker support Hindi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hindi is not on the language list in Notion's help center as of October 2026.
